company.name: afina DMP
company.shortDescription: afina DMP is an innovative platform that helps telecom operators to monetize their subscribers.
company.description: afina is an AI-based data monetization and advertising technology platform developed by IVT Communications FZE LLC. The company specializes in helping telecom operators monetize subscriber data securely through machine learning-powered audience targeting, predictive analytics, and omnichannel campaign delivery. Its platform analyzes anonymized behavioral data to deliver relevant promotional offers via SMS, RCS, IVR, push notifications, and digital advertising channels. afina focuses on privacy-first advertising, enabling telecom providers to increase ARPU, improve customer engagement, and unlock new revenue streams without compromising user trust or regulatory compliance. The platform operates globally with telecom and advertising partners across multiple regions and industries.
company.headquarters: Al Ajman, Ajman, United Arab Emirates
